title: SEC6: Runtime flag over compile-time for TLS-safe mode
description: g_tls_safe_mode is a runtime flag set by wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid(), not a compile-time #define. This is the right choice because it allows the same compiled library to support both TLS contexts (hash→software) and standalone crypto objects (hash→hardware) in the same process. A compile-time option would force a single global policy across all uses, preventing a server that uses hardware AES/HMAC for TLS but also runs standalone hash operations from routing those standalone hashes to hardware. The runtime flag is set precisely when the caller intends TLS use, making the API self-describing.
